requirements.requirement: On node1, display “Authorized access only” before local logins.
requirements.summary: The exact text is present in /etc/issue. The tty1 getty was active before and after reboot, and the recovered agetty process had no option suppressing the issue banner.

requirements.requirement: On node1, display “Authorized access only” before SSH logins.
requirements.summary: sshd resolved its Banner setting to /etc/issue.net, configuration validation passed, and live unauthenticated SSH probes displayed the exact text before authentication failure both before and after reboot.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied. The independent restart protocol is also coherent: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged the scheduled reboot, changed boot identity, returned to a running state, recovered sshd and getty, retained both banner files, and reproduced the live SSH banner. The fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: No literal local-console transcript or image was captured; local display is supported by the exact /etc/issue content and the active recovered agetty process.
The lifecycle inventory did not cover the conditional `.before-login-banner` backup paths, so their preexistence and final presence are unknown.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutation is established. The configuration writes, SELinux relabeling, sshd reload, and temporary-file cleanup directly supported the requested banners; the scheduled reboot supported the mandatory restart protocol. Afterward there were no failed services, additional listeners, or package-health regressions. The configuration command conditionally created three task-specific `.before-login-banner` backups and did not explicitly remove them, but the evidence does not reveal whether those files were newly created or already existed, so executor-caused residue cannot be concluded.
